significant_improvement: Selected full-split cross-entropy decrease greater than max(0.0001, 0.001 * last significant best loss). Selected split is training when trainSetLossOptimisation=true, validation when false.
scope: Fresh full-data training with selectable training- or validation-loss convergence for all 13 tabular datasets, five methods, three paired seeds; no source prefixes, no row subsampling or split-size caps.
initialization: Fresh models; no cancelled benchmark checkpoint or historical metrics are resumed.
split_rule: Official train/validation/test retained where provided; otherwise 20% of official train for validation; single-source datasets split 60/20/20. Banking Marketing uses only UCI bank-full.csv as one source, replacing the overlapping supplied splits. Stratification when class counts permit.
minimum_updates_rule: max(2000, ceil(number of training rows including configured repeats / 128)); at least one entire shuffled pass precedes stopping or plateau LR reductions.
stop: Selected-split loss plateau after at least three LR reductions. With trainSetLossOptimisation=true, also stop at 100% training accuracy and training CE <= 0.01 after minimum updates. With false, no perfect-training-fit stop. No maximum updates/epochs/time.
selection: Minimum full-training cross-entropy when trainSetLossOptimisation=true; minimum full-validation cross-entropy when false. Equal loss keeps the earlier checkpoint regardless of accuracy. Restore the full model and matching optimizer before final train/validation/test evaluation.
checkpoint: Resumable model, optimizer, controller, paired minibatch RNG/order/cursor, CPU/CUDA/noise RNG and curves; every 100 updates to SSD, durable backup every 300s and at completion.
population_backend: Verified batched iid full-model Gaussian estimator; direct CUDA RNG from first update. Same estimator and noise distribution as production; different RNG stream from sequential implementation.

numerical_recovery.policy: Restore the finite minimum selected-split loss model and matching optimizer, lower learning rate, log event. Exceeding limit is a failed run, never convergence.

initial_learning_rates: Adam repository per-dataset learning rate; population 0.01.
training_batch_policy: Carry the final remainder into the next shuffled pass; no training rows are dropped.
timing_note: Concurrent GPU jobs; durations are not controlled isolated performance comparisons.
target_caveat: Blog Feedback retains the repository count-as-classification task; this is not a regression benchmark.
validation_policy: With trainSetLossOptimisation=false, full validation loss controls checkpoint selection, patience and LR reductions. With true, validation is diagnostic only. Parameter updates use training minibatches only. Full test metrics are evaluated only after stopping and restoring the selected checkpoint. Benchmark partitions are identical in both modes.
banking_marketing_policy: Banking Marketing uses all 45,211 rows of UCI bank-full.csv, partitioned once into disjoint seeded train/validation/test splits (27,126/9,042/9,043). The overlapping bank.csv sample is not used.
